description: Profit and loss on a wallet's higher.fun coins, worked out from its own transactions on-chain, whichever app made them: SOL spent and received, average cost, realized profit on sells, and unrealized profit on what's still held, valued at what selling it all would return now. Without mints it covers the wallet's 5 largest holdings; name mints for others, or for coins it has sold out of. It reads up to 200 transactions; past that, notes say what's left out. Searching history needs an RPC that can: Solana's public RPC often times out.

history.description: Also list each coin's latest 20 transactions.

mints.description: At most 5 coins, held or sold out. Omit for the wallet's largest holdings.

items.description: The coin's mint address (base58). higher.fun mints usually end in 'high'.

name: get_wallet_pnl
title: Get wallet profit and loss
